mapper.select: SELECT * FROM policies ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM policies WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM policies WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.role='AGENT' AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM policies p WHERE p.agent_id=u.id AND p.status='ACTIVE'), u.name LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE policies SET customer_id=#{customerId}, agent_id=#{agentId}, premium=#{premium}, premium_status='DUE', status='ACTIVE' WHERE id=#{policyId}
UPDATE policies SET premium_status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
